考研词汇闪过 · 高频词 971 + 中频词 635

按原书「词根词缀 / 复合词拆分 / 微语境」三类记忆法分章 · Word List 1–21
0已掌握 1606总词数 0%完成度
⚠️ 词表来源与与原书的差异（务必先看）

1. 章节结构：完全按原书结构组织——高频词分「词根词缀记忆 WL1–7 / 复合词拆分记忆 WL8 / 微语境记忆 WL9–12」，中频词同样分「WL13–17 / WL18 / WL19–21」，共 21 个 Word List。
2. 词集合：取自考研大纲 5530 词，剔除初高中基础词后，按历年真题真实出现频次从高到低取前 971（高频）与 636–1606（中频）。与闪过官方定义（"真题中出现频率很高/较高的大纲词汇"）一致，词集合与原书高度重合但非逐词相同。
3. 关键差异：原书每个 List 内部按词根族聚类（如 WL1 是 vari/sign/oper/techn/tribut 族），此处按词频排序——所以「第几个词」对不上书，但「哪些词属于高频」是一致的。这是公开数据能做到的最贴近还原；原书逐页词表属版权内容，无法公开抓取。
4. 词频数字：每词右上角的数字 = 该词在约 200 套四六级/考研/专四专八试卷文本中的出现次数（词形还原后统计），可横向比较重要程度。
5. 每个词条包含：音标、中文释义（带词性）、英文释义、词根词缀拆解（对应原书的词根词缀记忆法）、例句及翻译、真题出现频次、主题分类。
6. 例句来源：百词斩公开释义库（非真题例句）。原书的「真题短语」无法获取，建议用实体书或三本精缩本补这部分。

an informal, often humorous, name for a person that is connected with their real name, their personality or appearance, or with something they have done
记nick挑毛病 + name名字 → nickname 绰号
If I call my dog's nickname, he'll come to me.
如果我叫狗狗的昵称，他就会向我跑来。
人类与社会
preside/prɪˈzaɪd/7
v.主持
to lead or be in charge of a meeting, ceremony, etc.
记pre前面 + side坐 → 在前面坐 → preside主持
The head of the company presided over this business conference.
公司领导主持了本次商务会议。
动作行为 其他动作
rip/rɪp/7
v. 撕开，扯破，裂开，敲诈； n. 裂缝，裂口
to tear something or to become torn, often suddenly or violently; to remove something quickly or violently, often by pulling it; to copy sound or video files from a website or CD on to a computer; to change text or images into a form in which they can be displayed on a screen or printed
Oh no! I ripped both the red envelop and the money!
不！我把钱连同红包一起撕破了！
动作行为 身体动作
vacuum/ˈvækjuəm/7
n. 真空吸尘器
the act of cleaning something with a vacuum cleaner
记vacu空 + um表名词 → vacuum空虚，真空
She is cleaning the carpet with a vacuum.
她在用吸尘器清理地毯。
日常生活
doze/doʊz/7
vi.瞌睡，假寐； n.瞌睡
to sleep lightly for a short time
I dozed a little at work today because I was so tired.
今天工作的时候，我打了会儿瞌睡，因为我太累了。
动作行为 身体动作
flap/flæp/7
v. 拍打，挥动； n. 拍打，挥动
if a bird flaps its wings, or if its wings flap, they move quickly up and down; to move or to make something move up and down or from side to side, often making a noise
The bird flaps its wings.
鸟拍打着翅膀。
动作行为 身体动作
hasty/ˈheɪsti/7
adj. 匆忙的；仓促完成的；草率的
(of a person) acting or deciding too quickly, without enough thought
He was hasty when running to the office.
他跑向办公室的时候显得很匆忙。
情感心理
impetus/ˈɪmpɪtəs/7
n.推动力；促进
the force or energy with which something moves
记im内 + petus=petere追寻，寻求 → 内在的追求 → 冲动
His boss's praise gives him the impetus to work harder.
老板的表扬给了他更加努力工作的动力。
动作行为 身体动作
lucrative/ˈluːkrətɪv/7
adj.合算的；获利的；有利可图的
producing a large amount of money; making a large profit
记lucr=lucre钱 + ative……的 → lucrative有利可图的
E-business is a lucrative industry which brings up many billionaires.
电商是一个很赚钱的行业，造就了很多亿万富翁。
商业经济
obedient/oʊˈbiːdiənt/7
adj. 服从的，顺从的
doing what you are told to do; willing to obey
记obedi=obed服从 + ent……的 → obedient服从的
The dog is obedient, and does whatever the boy wants.
这狗很听话，小男孩让它干嘛就干嘛。
情感心理
ozone/ˈoʊzoʊn/7
n. 臭氧；能使人兴奋的力量
a poisonous gas with a strong smell that is a form of oxygen
The ozone layer provides protection between the Sun and the Earth.
臭氧层在太阳和地球之间提供了保护。
自然环境
poke/poʊk/7
n. 戳，捅； v. 探（出），露出
the action of quickly pushing your fingers or another object into somebody/something
She poked him in the shoulder to get his attention.
她戳了戳他的肩膀以引起他的注意。
动作行为 身体动作
radiate/ˈreɪdieɪt/7
v. 辐射，发出（光或热）
if something radiates heat, light or energy or heat, etc. radiates from it, the heat is sent out in all directions
记radi光线 + ate造成、使之成…… → radiate辐射，（使）从中心发散
The sun radiates light and heat towards the earth.
太阳向地球发出光和热。
动作行为 变化趋势
rein/reɪn/7
n. 缰绳； v. 控制
a long narrow leather band that is attached to a metal bar in a horse’s mouth (= a bit) and is held by the rider in order to control the horse
You should hold the reins to lead your horse.
你应该握住缰绳来牵你的马。
日常生活
startle/ˈstɑːrtl/7
v. 惊吓
to surprise somebody suddenly in a way that slightly shocks or frightens them
记start开始 + le表动词 → 突然开始动起来 → startle使惊吓
The explosion of firecrackers startled the chicken.
鞭炮的爆炸声把鸡吓了一跳。
动作行为 身体动作
appraisal/əˈpreɪzl/7
n. 评估；估价；评价
a judgement of the value, performance or nature of somebody/something
记ap一再 + prais价值 + al表名词 → appraisal评价，估计
The appraisal of the house shows that it isn't very valuable.
估价显示这栋房子并不是很值钱。
商业经济
assurance/əˈʃʊrəns/7
n. 信心，自信；保证；保险
belief in your own abilities or strengths
记as=一再 + sur肯定 + ance表名词，状态、行为 → n.保证；把握；(人寿)保险
He gave me some much needed assurance.
他给了我急切需要的信心。
情感心理
bin/bɪn/7
n. 箱柜，仓，垃圾箱； v. 放入箱内
a container that you put waste in; a large container, usually with a lid, for storing things in
Separate all of your glass, paper, and metal recycling in the different bins.
回收时应分别把玻璃，纸制品和金属品放入不同的垃圾箱中。
日常生活
bullet/ˈbʊlɪt/7
n. 子弹，枪弹
a small piece of metal or another material that is shot out of a gun
记bull球 + et表示小 → bullet子弹，枪弹
Here are several different types of bullets.
这里是几种不同种类的子弹。
政治法律
despise/dɪˈspaɪz/7
vt.轻视，蔑视，看不起
(not used in the progressive tenses) to dislike and have no respect for somebody/something
记de减低 + spise看→ despise鄙视
The dog despises the cat for licking her ass.
狗狗鄙视舔自己屁屁的猫。
情感心理
exclaim/ɪkˈskleɪm/7
v. 呼叫，惊叫
to say something suddenly and loudly, especially because of strong emotion or pain
记ex出 + claim叫喊 → exclaim叫喊，大声说
"Help!" the woman exclaimed as the man stole her bag.
这个男人偷了她的包，她大喊：“帮帮我！”
动作行为 社交交互
feat/fiːt/7
n. 绝技，功绩，武艺
an action or a piece of work that needs skill, strength or courage
记feat=fact做大事 → n.绝技，本领；功绩，功劳
Swallowing a solid steel sword is an amazing feat!
吞钢剑真是一门神奇的技艺！
抽象概念 认知与抽象名词
instantaneous/ˌɪnstənˈteɪniəs/7
adj.瞬间的，即刻的
happening immediately
记instant马上的 + aneous表形容词 → 马上发生的 → 同时发生的
When stabbing the balloon, there was an instantaneous burst.
如果用针扎这个气球，它会瞬间爆炸。
时间日期
intact/ɪnˈtækt/7
adj.完好无缺的，原封未动的
complete and not damaged
记in没有 + tact接触 → 未触动的；完整的
The glass remained intact after it was dropped.
这个玻璃杯掉了下来，但依然完好无缺。
抽象概念 性质与评价
intrude/ɪnˈtruːd/7
v.闯入，侵入；把（自己的思想）强加于人
to become involved with something private in an annoying way
记in向内，进入+trude推出→推进去→挤进
A bad guy intruded into my house with a knife.
一个坏人拿着刀闯入了我的房子。
动作行为 心理活动
metaphor/ˈmetəfər/7
n. 暗喻，隐喻
a word or phrase used to describe somebody/something else, in a way that is different from its normal use, in order to show that the two things have the same qualities and to make the description more powerful, for example She has a heart of stone; the use of such words and phrases
记meta超过，改变 + phor带来 → 语言改变着说 → metaphor隐喻
"This city is the heart of the country"; here, "heart" is used as a metaphor.
“这座城市是这个国家的心脏”，在这句话中，“心脏”是一种隐喻。
文化宗教
moan/moʊn/7
v.抱怨；呻吟；呜咽；发牢骚； n.呻吟声；呜咽声；怨声；牢骚
(of a person) to make a long deep sound, usually expressing unhappiness, suffering or sexual pleasure
She moans that there is no suitable dress to wear.
她抱怨着没有合适的衣服穿。
动作行为 身体动作
muscular/ˈmʌskjələr/7
adj. 肌肉发达的；肌肉的；强有力的
having large strong muscles
记muscul肌肉 + ar形容词后缀 → muscular肌肉发达的
The muscular man is lifting weights in the gym.
这个肌肉发达的男人正在健身房里举重。
人类与社会
nuisance/ˈnuːsns/7
n. 讨厌的人；麻烦事；伤害
a thing, person or situation that is annoying or causes trouble or problems
The boy who keeps pulling the girl's hair is really a nuisance!
那个男生一直在扯女生的头发，真是个讨厌鬼！
情感心理
relativity/ˌreləˈtɪvəti/7
n. 相对性
Einstein’s theory of the universe based on the principle that all movement is relative and that time is a fourth dimension related to space
记relativ=relate联系 + ity表名词 → relativity相关性
Einstein introduced the theory of relativity.
爱因斯坦提出了相对论。
科学技术
removal/rɪˈmuːvl/7
n.消除
the act of taking somebody/something away from a particular place; the act of getting rid of something
记re一再，重新 + mov=move移动 + al表名词 → removal移动，迁移
The hair removal roller is very useful.
这个除毛滚筒很有用。
动作行为 其他动作
rifle/ˈraɪfl/7
n. 步枪； v. 洗劫，抢劫
a gun with a long barrel which you hold to your shoulder to fire
There is a rifle on the ground.
地上有一把步枪。

sincere/sɪnˈsɪr/7
adj. 真诚的，诚恳的
genuine or real :not false, fake, or pretended
He showed me his love with a sincere expression.
他表情诚恳地对我表达了爱意。
情感心理
alienate/ˈeɪliəneɪt/7
v.疏远；挑拨
to make somebody feel that they do not belong in a particular group
记ali其他的，改变状态 + en表形容词或名词 + ate使 → 把别人当外国人 → alienate疏远
He was alienated by his friends just because he was different.
他因为与众不同而被他的朋友们疏远了。

ascend/əˈsend/7
v. 沿着……上升，攀登
to rise; to go up; to climb up
记a加强意义 + scend爬，攀 → ascend登上，爬上
The walking group are ascending to the summit of the mountain.
这个徒步团队正在向山顶攀登。
动作行为 变化趋势
